intro.title: Introduction
intro.text: On Safqa, we take your privacy very seriously and are committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains how information is collected, used, protected, and kept confidential.

collectedInfo.title: Information we collect
collectedInfo.text: We may collect information necessary to provide Safqa services and improve the user experience, including:

info.name: Name or username.
info.email: Email address and contact information associated with the account.
info.image: Profile picture or images the user chooses to upload to the platform.

collectedInfo.technical: Technical information such as device type, operating system, IP address, and usage data necessary to operate and improve the service.

points.p1: Create and manage user accounts and provide platform services.
points.p2: Enable users to post listings, communicate, and complete buy and sell transactions.
points.p3: Improve platform performance, develop features and services, and enhance the user experience.
points.p4: Protect the platform and users from fraud, misuse, and unauthorized activities.

consent.title: User consent
consent.text: By using Safqa and creating an account, you acknowledge that you have read the privacy policy and understood how your information is collected and used according to this policy.

points.external: We do not sell users' personal data. Some information may be shared with trusted service providers when necessary to operate the platform and provide its services.
points.law: We may disclose information when required by law, in response to a valid legal request, or to protect the rights of the platform and users.

protection.title: Information protection
protection.text: We use appropriate technical and organizational measures to help protect user information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, the security of any electronic system cannot be absolutely guaranteed.

updates.title: Privacy policy updates
updates.text: We may update the privacy policy from time to time to keep up with changes in our services or legal requirements. The updated version will be posted on this page with the last modified date updated.

points.p1: Request to know the personal information associated with your account.
points.p2: Request to correct or update inaccurate information.
points.p3: Request deletion of the account and personal information, in accordance with legal requirements and obligations necessary to provide the service.
points.p4: File a complaint with the Israeli Privacy Protection Authority if you believe your data processing violates applicable law.

retention.title: Data retention period
retention.text: We retain your personal data as long as your account is active on the platform. Upon account deletion, data may be deleted or anonymized within a reasonable period, except for data that must be retained for legal, accounting, or dispute resolution purposes.

messages.title: Messages between users
messages.text: We do not routinely monitor the content of private messages between users. Message logs may be retained for a limited period for operational and security purposes. Message content is not disclosed to any third party except under a court order or an official request from a competent authority in accordance with applicable law.

external.title: Service providers and data transfer
external.text: We do not sell users' personal data. Information may be shared with service providers necessary to operate the platform, such as payment, hosting, login, and notification providers. This may involve transferring some data to servers outside Israel, in accordance with appropriate data protection standards and safeguards.

userConsent.title: User consent to communications
userConsent.text: We may contact you regarding your account, listings, transactions, security, important notifications, or service-related updates. You can manage some types of notifications through your account settings.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.text: If you have any questions or requests regarding the privacy policy or your personal data, you can contact the Safqa team through the contact page.
contact.phone: You can also use the official contact methods available within the Safqa platform.

disputes.title: Dispute resolution
disputes.subtitle: Because your trust matters, we're here to support you when any disagreement occurs. We ensure a transparent and fair process for everyone.
disputes.processSubtitle: Follow these steps to resolve any dispute quickly and fairly

step1.title: Communicate first
step1.desc: In most cases, disagreements can be resolved through direct communication and mutual respect. Try to negotiate wisely and be patient with the other party.
step1.tip1: Be clear and specific in your requests

step2.title: Report the problem
step2.desc: If no solution is reached, use the report button within the deal. Provide clear evidence such as images, conversations, and listing details.
step2.tip2: Write a detailed description of the problem

step3.title: Dispute review
step3.desc: The Safqa team reviews the details and compares the information provided by both parties. We verify the evidence and apply platform policies.
step3.tip1: Be prepared to provide additional information

step4.title: Support and assistance
step4.desc: We contact you to find a fair solution that protects the rights of all parties. We provide recommendations and final decisions based on policies.
step4.tip2: Make sure you understand the outcome

disputes.issue1: Product does not match the description
disputes.issue3: Payment made but product not received
disputes.issue5: Price different from what was agreed
disputes.resolutionSubtitle: We offer several methods to resolve disputes depending on the nature of the problem

resolution1.title: Amicable settlement
resolution1.desc: An agreement between both parties on a compromise accepted by all, under platform supervision.

resolution2.title: Direct intervention
resolution2.desc: A decision by the support team based on evidence and specific policies.

resolution3.title: Final resolution
resolution3.desc: A final decision with disciplinary action if necessary, such as account suspension.

disputes.finalNote: Our goal at Safqa is to build a fair, transparent, and safe C2C marketplace for everyone. We ensure our neutrality and act based on evidence and published policies.

safety.title: Safety first
safety.subtitle: At Safqa, we care about a safe buying and selling experience for everyone. Follow these guidelines to ensure safe and guaranteed transactions

tip1.title: Verify the other party
tip1.desc: Review the user's ratings and activity history before completing any deal. Check previous reviews and the number of successful transactions.

tip2.title: Avoid prepayment
tip2.desc: Do not transfer money before receiving the product or verifying its condition. Use cash on delivery or secure systems for large transactions.

tip3.title: Choose a safe place
tip3.desc: For in-person delivery, prefer meeting in a public, well-lit place such as shopping centers or dedicated deal locations. Avoid isolated places.

tip4.title: Watch out for suspicious offers
tip4.desc: A very low price or unjustified urgency may indicate fraud. Verify the product in person if possible and make sure it matches the description.

safety.warning2: Psychological pressure to complete the deal quickly

levels.title: Safety levels
levels.subtitle: Choose the appropriate safety level for your deals
levels.highDesc: Hand-to-hand delivery in a public place

safety.finalNote: Safqa is a C2C platform. Your commitment to safety guidelines helps us maintain a trusted community. Direct safety responsibility lies with the buyer and seller, and we work to provide the tools that help with that.

selling.description: Follow these simple steps to sell your products quickly and safely
selling.subtitle: Follow these simple steps to sell your products quickly and safely
selling.step1Desc: Start by adding a clear image and an attractive title for your product.
selling.step2Desc: Add a brief, accurate description with important details for the buyer.
selling.step3Desc: Set an appropriate price. You can add discounts to attract buyers.
selling.step4Desc: Review all information then click publish. Your listing will be visible to buyers.

selling.needHelpDesc: Our support team is ready to help you at any step of the selling journey. We're here to ensure you have the best possible experience.

terms.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before using the Safqa platform

importantPoints.age: You must be 12 years or older to use the platform.
importantPoints.registration: Registration is required to post listings.
importantPoints.c2c: Safqa is a C2C platform, and users are responsible for buy and sell transactions between them.
importantPoints.legalAddress: The platform is subject to the laws and regulations in force within its legal jurisdiction.

prohibitedItems.title: Prohibited products and activities
prohibitedItems.text: It is strictly prohibited to post, sell, or buy any of the following through Safqa. We reserve the right to delete any violating listing and suspend the responsible account without prior notice:
points: Firearms, ammunition, and weapon parts, except under a valid official license from the competent authorities.
Drugs and any substances prohibited for trade under Israeli law.
Prescription medicines or any pharmaceutical products not licensed for public sale.
Counterfeit products or products infringing intellectual property or trademarks.
Stolen goods or goods of illegal or undocumented origin.
Alcohol or tobacco products for minors.
Hazardous, flammable, or explosive materials and fireworks.
Live animals or products derived from endangered species, contrary to applicable laws.
Content or products of a sexual or pornographic nature.
Official documents, identification data, or personal information of third parties.
Tickets or services prohibited from resale by law.
Any other product or service prohibited by Israeli law or requiring a license the seller does not hold.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.text: You must be 12 years or older to use the platform. By using the platform, you acknowledge and confirm that you meet these requirements.

registration.title: Registration and account creation
registration.text: You are required to create an account to post listings and advertisements on the platform. You are responsible for providing accurate and up-to-date information and maintaining the confidentiality of your password. We reserve the right to suspend or delete any account in case of suspicious activity or violation of our privacy policy.

products.title: Products and listings
products.text: Prices, product availability, and descriptions may change at any time. We act as an intermediary platform and do not guarantee the accuracy of the information provided in listings.

platform.title: Platform nature
platform.text: Safqa is a C2C (user-to-user) platform that allows users to display and buy products directly from each other. We do not store products or provide delivery or pickup services.

legalAddress.title: Legal address
legalAddress.address: Ein Al-Dhahra Street, Umm Al-Fahm, Israel.
legalAddress.note: This address is considered the official legal address for all notices and legal correspondence.

userConduct.title: User conduct
points: Do not use the platform for illegal purposes.
Do not impersonate another person or provide false information.
Do not upload malicious code or interfere with the proper operation of the platform.
Do not attempt to access systems you are not authorized to use.
userConduct.warning: Violating these terms may result in account suspension, blocking, or legal action.

blocking.title: Blocking and user interaction
blocking.text: A user may block another user to protect their privacy and prevent unwanted interaction. When blocking is activated, it is applied to both parties according to the Safqa blocking system.
points: When a user blocks another, the two parties cannot message each other, send offers, or perform direct interactions between them.
The blocked user's listings are hidden from the blocking user, and vice versa.
Blocked listings do not appear in search results, categories, or related listings for the other party.
The blocked user cannot access the other party's listings through direct links.
The user can manage the blocked users list and unblock at any time.
Safqa may retain blocking records necessary for security and abuse prevention purposes.

step2.title: Open profile

step3.title: Choose delete account

step4.title: Confirm deletion

dataDeletion.title: Data that gets deleted
dataDeletion.intro: When you delete your account, data associated with your account is deleted or removed in accordance with Safqa policies, and may include:
dataDeletion.accountData: Account data and associated personal information.

retained.title: Data that may be retained

support.title: Can't access your account?
